local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
local Shared = require( 'Module:UnitData' )

-- mw.logObject(p.Statis_list())

local p = {}
local uData    = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data')
local uData_N  = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data/Names')
local uData_AT = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data/AoE_Type')



function toNil(thing)         if thing == nil or thing == '' then return nil else  return thing end end
function toEmptyString(thing) if thing == nil or thing == '' then  return "" else  return thing end end



function p.Statis_list(f) 
	local args = getArgs(f, {
        wrapper = 'Template:Statistics_list'
    })
	return f:preprocess(Statis_list(args))
end 



function Statis_list()
	local function compareNames(a, b)
	    return a.name < b.name
	end
	local sortedData = {}
	for _, value in pairs(uData) do
	    table.insert(sortedData, value)
	end
	table.sort(sortedData, compareNames)
	
	local template = ""
	
	for id, unit in pairs(sortedData) do
		id = unit.id
		-- template = template ..'|Damage='.. Shared.get({args = {name = unit.name, "upgrade", 'damage', 'max'} })
		-- template = template ..'|Range='.. Shared.get({args = {name = unit.name, "upgrade", 'range', 'max'} })
		-- template = template ..'|SPA='.. Shared.get({args = {name = unit.name, "upgrade", 'attack_cooldown', 'max'} })
		-- template = template ..'|tower_type='.. Shared.get({args = {name = unit.name, "tower_type"} })
		-- template = template ..'|attack_type='.. Shared.get({args = {name = unit.name, "attack_type"} })
		if toNil(uData[id]) then
			if toNil(unit.upgrade) then
				if toNil(unit.upgrade[1]) then
					template = template ..'{{Statistics-TableBlock|'.. unit.name
					template = template ..'|total_cost='.. (Shared.get({args = {name = tostring(id), "total_cost"} }) or ' ')
					template = template ..'|attack_type='.. (Shared.get({args = {name = id, "attack_type"} }) or ' ')
					template = template ..'|tower_type='.. (Shared.get({args = {name = id, "tower_type"} }) or ' ')
					template = template ..'|Damage='.. (Shared.get({args = {name = tostring(id), "upgrade", 'damage', 'max'} }) or ' ')
					template = template ..'|Range='.. (Shared.get({args = {name = tostring(id), "upgrade", 'range', 'max'} }) or ' ')
					template = template ..'|SPA='.. (Shared.get({args = {name = tostring(id), "upgrade", 'attack_cooldown', 'max'} }) or ' ') .. "}}\n"
				end
			end
		end
		-- template = template ..'{{'.. template ..'}}'
	end
	return template
end

return p
